title: Bontrager Hard-Case Max Pro TLR Road Tire
notes: Official Trek US page read 2026-11-01: US$64.99; 'built for high-mileage riding' with a durable design against flats. 60 TPI; Race Dual-Compound (65a); Hard-Case construction; semi-slick; tubeless ready/clincher. 700C x 26 mm 370 g, 75-100 psi; 28 mm 405 g, 70-100 psi; 32 mm 500 g, 55-75 psi; 35 mm 515 g, 50-70 psi. No hookless statement.
